chunks: He replied: "You know that none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth has sent these (signs) as cogent proof. I truly think, O Pharaoh, your days are done."

key_terms.رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ: Lord of the heavens and the earth

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to Pharaoh regarding the source of the miracles?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Moses (AS) addresses Pharaoh, acknowledging his innate recognition of the divine source of the miracles as 'basā'ir' (cogent proofs or lights), thereby refuting Pharaoh's claim of ignorance. The term 'basā'ir' emphasizes the clarity and multiplicity of signs that left no room for doubt, leading to the prophetic declaration of Pharaoh's impending ruin ('mathbūrān'). This interaction underscores the Shia scholarly view that true faith requires not just witnessing miracles but recognizing their divine origin amidst arrogance.
